metadata.title: Market Loses Steam Along With Nvidia Stock

content.text:
Last Updated:
Updated 12 min ago
Nvidia’s earnings weren’t giving the stock market a boost. Even the chip maker couldn’t hold onto earlier gains.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 320 points, or 0.7%. The S&P 500 was down 0.2%. The Nasdaq Composite was flat.
Nvidia fell 0.4% after jumping at the open after the firm’s results topped expectations and executives sought to make investors more comfortable with a future beyond Jensen Huang. The stock was higher in after-hours trading but lost steam.
